# Learned instinct: gitlab-protected-branch-two-approvals (confidence 0.95)

All environment branches (test, staging, prod) must be protected with a minimum of 2 MR approvals and author-cannot-approve enabled. No force-push or deletion allowed. This enforces separation of duties (PCI Req 6.5) at the source control level. Maintainer direct-push is for break-glass only and must be governance-ledger-logged.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 6.5 (change control); Req 8.3 (SoD)
